rv.q: Seldom do either of these theatre companies disappoint, and this production, their re-entrance into the much-awaited world of live theatre in Chicago, is as strong as ever.
This is a top pick for anyone who admires seeing world class talented actors at the top of their game.
This Wide Night is presented by Shattered Globe Theatre in association with Interrobang Theatre Project , and runs through Nov 13.
Despite an interesting set of premises and impressive acting by Aila Ayilam Peck (Marie) and Linda Reiter (Lorraine), “This Wide Night” by Chloë Moss is ponderous to watch.

cn.t: Strong performances anchor this intimate drama about ex-cons struggling to reintegrate, though critics split on whether the slow-burn storytelling feels ponderous or gorgeously heartbreaking.
